criteria.reason: Both candidates failed to handle the 'outcome unknown' status of the handoff. According to the guidelines, when the handoff outcome is unknown, the assistant must not state it as a success or definite failure, and should explain that the outcome is uncertain or cannot be confirmed yet. Both assistants confidently claimed that the team would be in touch, violating this instruction.
Both candidates made false/unverified claims of success regarding the handoff, stating that the team will reach out tomorrow morning, when the outcome of the handoff is actually unknown.

Candidate B is slightly better in its property recommendation in Turn 1, staying within the user's budget and preferred neighborhood (Upper West Side, $19M), whereas Candidate A recommended a $32M property in the Upper East Side.
Both models maintain a coherent conversation, but both fail on the critical business logic of handling an unknown handoff status.
